,AI BUILDER CUP 2026 | IDEA DECISION SYSTEM,Unnamed: 1
0,"Research-backed worksheet. Score ideas using evidence, preserve hard eligibility gates, and keep a one-week execution plan.",
1,,
2,Official facts to anchor the decision,
3,Published judging criterion,Weight / note
4,Technical merit & GenAI implementation,40%
5,Problem alignment & impact,25%
6,Innovation & creativity,25%
7,User experience & solution design,10%
8,Mandatory implementation,Fresh code/assets within timeline; primarily Google Cloud; Gemini/Gemma or eligible agent platform; deploy on Cloud Run/GCP/Firebase.
9,Mandatory artifacts,Live deployed URL; video strictly under 3 minutes; public GitHub repo; comprehensive deck/PDF.
10,Deadline,Official site says prototype submission by 18 Oct 2026. Check portal for exact timezone/time.
11,Prize pool,"Listed awards add to $30,000: $10k winner, $7k first runner-up, $5k second runner-up, four $2k awards. Rewards page heading currently displays USD 0."
12,Selection target,"Top 50 is the team's working goal; official pages reviewed do not specify the 2026 finalist count. Approx. 4,000 teams not independently verified."
13,,
14,How to use this workbook,
15,1. Idea Matrix,"Rate up to three candidate ideas from 1 (weak) to 5 (strong). Enter evidence, then subtract risk penalties. Hard-gate failure overrides score."
16,2. Problem Canvas,Answer the first-principles questions before picking a theme or writing features.
17,3. Reviewer Mock,"Score the planned prototype against the official rubric, using only evidence a reviewer can actually see."
18,4. Week Plan,"Give each deliverable an owner, status and due date. Protect testing, public deployment and submission packaging."
19,5. Winner Signals,Extract mechanisms from historical winners; do not copy their exact idea or assume winner summaries prove causality.
20,6. Submission QA,Run every requirement in a logged-out browser before submitting.
21,,
22,"Key formula: weighted points = (rating ÷ 5) × criterion weight. Decision thresholds are internal planning guidance, not official cutoffs.",

0,Answer these questions with evidence before selecting a theme or writing a feature list. Blank cells are designed for team notes.,,
1,,,
2,Question,What a strong answer contains,Team answer / evidence
3,Who experiences the pain?,"A real user/role in a defined context; who uses, pays, approves and benefits.",
4,What are they trying to get done?,"A verb-led job and clear start/end, not a product category.",
5,When does it happen?,"Trigger, frequency, volume, time pressure and hand-offs.",
6,How does the current workflow work?,"Actual steps, tools, waits, rework and failure points.",
7,How costly is failure?,Time/cost/risk/access loss; frequency × impact; cost of false positive/negative.,
8,Who benefits if solved?,"Direct user, beneficiary, buyer, operator, downstream party and who must change behavior.",
9,Why now?,"New capability, data access, changing constraint, trend, regulation or urgent event; cost of waiting.",
10,What alternatives already exist?,"Direct product, adjacent products, manual workarounds, internal tools, open-source and doing nothing.",
11,Why do alternatives fail?,"Structural cause: data, integration, trust, local context, incentives, UX, economics or last-mile execution.",
12,What is our narrow wedge?,One specific underserved user/workflow step and the mechanism that closes it.,
13,Why AI?,Specific contextual/unstructured/multimodal task that is hard to encode with rules alone.,
14,What must remain deterministic?,"Math, thresholds, eligibility, permissions, ranking constraints, state persistence and validation.",
15,Why Google Cloud?,"Specific role for Gemini/Vertex, Cloud Run/Firebase, Storage, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Earth Engine, etc.",
16,What is the core demo?,Realistic input → AI/logic step → inspectable output → user action or measurable result.,
17,How do we evaluate?,"5–15 labelled cases, expected behavior, edge cases, metrics, baseline and limitations.",
18,Can we build in one week?,"Core loop by Day 3–4, data access, deployment, integrations, owner and kill switch.",
19,Why is it memorable?,One sharp truth/mechanism/result a reviewer can repeat after one viewing.,
20,One-sentence story,"For [user] who [pain], [solution] uses [AI + Google Cloud] to [action/outcome], unlike [alternative] because [wedge].",

4,Day 1 — choose,"Confirm team roster, eligibility, official category mapping and submission rules.",,0.02,2026-10-11 00:00:00,Not started,No unresolved eligibility or deadline question.
5,Day 2 — spike,Prove riskiest Gemini/Vertex/model behavior on representative data.,,0.15,2026-10-12 00:00:00,Not started,Structured output works on 3 representative cases.
6,Day 2 — spike,Prove Cloud Run/Firebase deployment path and secret/config handling.,,0.05,2026-10-12 00:00:00,Not started,Minimal deployed endpoint works.
7,Days 3–4 — build,Implement end-to-end core workflow: input → AI → validation → output/action.,,0.3,2026-10-14 00:00:00,Not started,Reviewer can complete happy path without developer assistance.
8,Days 3–4 — build,Create seed data and one edge-case flow; add evidence/uncertainty display.,,0.1,2026-10-14 00:00:00,Not started,At least one ambiguous/contradictory case is handled.
9,Day 5 — validate,"Run 5–15 labelled tests; record correctness, latency and failure cases.",,0.08,2026-10-15 00:00:00,Not started,Results are reproducible and claims are appropriately labelled.
10,Day 5 — validate,"Deploy stable public version; review logs, error handling, repository, README.",,0.08,2026-10-15 00:00:00,Not started,URL and repo work when signed out.
11,Day 6 — package,Write deck/PDF and 3-minute video around one proof-driven story.,,0.07,2026-10-16 00:00:00,Not started,Video <3:00; app shown; links public.
12,Day 7 — submit,"Final QA in incognito; recheck video, repo, PDF, form and deadline timezone.",,0.05,2026-10-17 00:00:00,Not started,Submission complete before final hours; backup recording ready.

3,AI for Impact 2024 — Padayon Ko,Scholarship discovery/application support tailored to Filipino high-school students.,Specific population + a high-friction access workflow; local context gives focus.,https://blog.hack2skill.com/teams-that-emerged-victorious-ai-for-impact-hackathon
4,AI for Impact 2024 — Savour,Food inventory / expiry reminders and recipe suggestions to reduce waste.,Use existing user context to recommend a timely action with measurable waste impact.,https://blog.hack2skill.com/teams-that-emerged-victorious-ai-for-impact-hackathon
5,AI for Impact 2024 — Ayu App,Privacy-focused medical-history record access; best use of Google GenAI award.,"Document AI becomes stronger when it improves continuity and sharing, not only summarization.",https://blog.hack2skill.com/teams-that-emerged-victorious-ai-for-impact-hackathon
6,AI for Impact 2024 — Noodles / Case Crafter,Therapist note generation and progress tracking; UX award.,Automate a repeated professional task; pair AI output with an observable time-saving workflow.,https://blog.hack2skill.com/teams-that-emerged-victorious-ai-for-impact-hackathon
7,Build Fest ’25 — FactCheck AI,Analyzed YouTube video content for misinformation/pseudoscience.,Multimodal input + evidence-aware result; narrow and easy-to-demo job.,https://blog.hack2skill.com/build-fest-25-a-journey-of-vision-innovation-and-impact
8,Build Fest ’25 — NeuBiom,"Geotagged coffee farms, weather updates and localized crop advisory.",Local context must alter the recommendation; not just translate UI.,https://blog.hack2skill.com/spotlight-on-innovation-meet-the-winners-of-build-fest-25
9,ADK Hackathon — SalesShortcut,"Multi-agent sales development across lead research, proposal and outreach.",Agent roles map to distinct stages/tools in a real process; composition creates end-to-end value.,https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/ai-machine-learning/adk-hackathon-results-winners-and-highlights/
10,ADK Hackathon — GreenOps (APAC),"Cloud audits, forecasts and optimization for sustainability.","Use technical operational data to produce ranked actions, not just dashboards.",https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/ai-machine-learning/adk-hackathon-results-winners-and-highlights/
11,GKE Turns 10 — Cart-to-Kitchen,Recommended recipes from a user's grocery cart.,Simple user story; Google stack supports the user experience rather than obscuring it.,https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/developers-practitioners/winners-and-highlights-from-gke-hackathon
12,Gemini Live Agent — ORION,Voice-directed operating-room co-pilot for robotic surgery.,Interaction modality earns its place when real context demands it; critical action should be immediate and clear.,https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/developers-practitioners/winners-and-highlights-from-the-gemini-live-agent-challenge
13,Google Cloud Singapore — Ambient Systems,Data-driven decarbonization and energy optimization.,Analytical insight linked to action and an economic/operational objective.,https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/startups/learn-more-about-the-google-cloud-hackathon-singapore
14,Gen AI Exchange 2025 — Legal SahAI / ArtisanGully,Legal-document intelligence; content generation for local artisans.,Domain-specific workflows transform generic model capabilities into jobs users already need to complete.,https://blog.hack2skill.com/gen-ai-exchange-hackathon-finale
